title: A Study of TAK-360 in People with Narcolepsy or Idiopathic Hypersomnia
official: A Long-term Extension Trial to Evaluate the Safety and Tolerability of TAK-360 in Participants with Selected Central Hypersomnia Conditions
summary: Main objective: To evaluate the long-term safety and tolerability of TAK-360.
criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
1. 1. Participant has a confirmed diagnosis of either narcolepsy with cataplexy (NT1), narcolepsy without cataplexy (NT2), or idiopathic hypersomnia (IH) and completed the treatment period of a parent TAK-360 trial.
Exclusion criteria:
1. 1. Participant has a known hypersensitivity to any component of the formulation of TAK-360 or related compounds.
2. 2. Participant has a positive pregnancy test at screening or is breastfeeding.
